answer: A mechanism that actually bites: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because ripple only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, lotus is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
